items.headline: OpenAI ARR ~$50B per Sept-end investor update (Bloomberg/FT, Oct 8); Axios scoop had reported ~$70B (Sep 29)
items.why: Narrows gap with Anthropic's reported ARR; raises scrutiny on burn vs valuation amid AI spending race

items.headline: DeepSeek reportedly nears $12B funding round led by Tencent, CATL ahead of 2027 IPO
items.why: Signals China's top LLM lab locking in mega capital and new backers before going public — key read on domestic AI financing depth

items.headline: AI compute startup Lambda to raise up to $4B at $14.5B pre-money valuation ahead of planned IPO
items.why: Major neocloud GPU-rental financing round signals continued capital inflow into AI compute infrastructure outside hyperscalers

items.headline: Nvidia faces scrutiny over AI chips reaching China via smuggling scheme, per US prosecutors' evidence
items.why: Raises enforcement/compliance risk around export controls and Nvidia's China exposure, a persistent overhang on the stock

items.headline: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
items.why: Would mark a further leap from OpenAI's $852B March 2026 valuation, underscoring investor appetite for AI-lab equity despite no IPO
